## About
Catherine's Auto Repair is a full-service shop on Piedmont Circle NE in Atlanta. Our slogan is "Respect for you and your car," and we treat it as a promise: honesty, integrity, quality work and good customer service at a fair price.
We will never sell you something you don't need, and we won't pressure you. We share the results of every test and inspection, explain your options, and let you choose what makes sense for you right now.
Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating across 138 Google reviews. Many of them mention talking with Catherine herself, and we hope you will too.

## Services
- Maintenance and repairs on most makes: We work on nearly all makes and models of cars and light trucks, domestic and import.
- Oil change and plugs: An oil change, with plugs replaced when it's time.
- Air conditioning: Diagnosis and repair of your car's A/C system.
- Cars towed in: If you break down in Atlanta, you can have your car towed here and we will take a look.

## FAQ
Q: How will I know what my car needs?
A: We send you a report through our online portal with photos and explanations, so you can see what needs to be done and why before you decide.

Q: What makes of cars do you work on?
A: Most domestic and import makes, including Acura, Audi, BMW, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet and many more.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. Use the key dropbox next to the front door and we will take it from there.
